project_info.theme: Shopee Sao Thi Sao 2 fantasy cast poster
project_info.color_palette: Dark stone gray, crimson red, orange, gold, black

main_subject.detail: A dramatic ensemble poster set in a fantasy stone hall. Center banner reads 'SHOPEE SAO THI SAO 2' and a wooden sign says 'TAP 2'. Nine cast members in black robes with orange accents pose in rows with visible name tags such as 'UPRIZE WONBI', 'UPRIZE LAVM', 'UPRIZE O.D', 'UPRIZE BEX', 'UPRIZE PN', 'UPRIZE LEON', 'UPRIZE DYLAN', 'NGOC PHUOC', 'TUAN KIET', and 'DUONG QUOC MY'. A Shopee box mascot with crown and sunglasses stands behind them. Giant glowing title reads 'CUP THAN DAI CHIEN' and the subtitle says 'TAP 2: AI SE BI HAC HOA TIEP THEO'. Footer reads 'DON XEM TAI Shopee LIVE 12H30 | 15.7 - 25.7'.
main_subject.style: High-drama fantasy poster with photo-composite cast cutouts, cinematic lighting, glowing title treatment, and magical-school costumes
